name: Who God Is
overview: Scripture reveals God as the unchanging, perfect, and truthful Creator who cannot lie or fail to fulfill His promises, as affirmed in Numbers 23:19 and Deuteronomy 32:4. He is self-existent, declaring Himself 'I AM' to Moses, emphasizing His eternal and sovereign nature (Exodus 3:14). God is spirit and demands worship in spirit and truth (John 4:24), and through Jesus, who is the way, the truth, and the life, believers have access to the Father (John 14:6). The impossible for man is possible with God, highlighting His omnipotence and divine power (Luke 18:27).
